# Katherine Sinclair — Managing Partner, Stonehaven Capital Partners

- **Goes by:** Kate
- **Full name:** Katherine Sinclair
- **Role:** Managing Partner; member of the Investment Committee (IC). Leads the firm's
  **healthcare-services** and **B2B software** verticals.
- **Firm:** [Stonehaven Capital Partners](../context/company.md) (SCP) — a mid-market
  private-equity firm doing control buyouts in the lower middle market (~$2.5B AUM across
  three funds).
- **Reports to:** [William Stonehaven](../people/william-stonehaven.md), Founder & Senior
  Managing Partner (chairs the IC).
- **Tenure:** joined SCP in 2012 as a Principal; promoted to Partner in 2016 and Managing
  Partner in 2021. Previously an investor at a larger buyout shop and, before that, an
  M&A banker.

## Mandate
Source, underwrite, and close control buyouts in healthcare services and B2B software;
oversee value creation and eventual exits across her portfolio companies; represent SCP to
limited partners (LPs) in her verticals. Kate sponsors the confidential
[Onyx](../projects/onyx.md) transaction and the [Halberd](../projects/halberd.md) platform
acquisition, and she sits on the boards of
[Cedar Park Health](../projects/cedar-park-health.md),
[Blue Harbor Software](../projects/blue-harbor-software.md), and
[Meadowlark Dental](../projects/meadowlark-dental.md).

## Current top priorities (2026 H2)
1. **Close [Onyx](../projects/onyx.md)** — the live acquisition she is sponsoring (confidential).
2. **[Halberd](../projects/halberd.md)** — platform buyout; a diligence problem just put it
   **at risk** and she has to decide whether to re-trade or walk.
3. **[Ironwood Industrial](../projects/ironwood-industrial.md) exit** — run the sale process to a
   clean close.
4. **Deploy [Fund III](../projects/fund-iii.md)** — the fund is ~55% deployed; keep the pace
   without overpaying, and keep LPs warm.

## What's eating Kate's time
- Halberd re-trade decision after the quality-of-earnings (QoE) finding.
- Onyx SPA (sale & purchase agreement) negotiation heading into signing.
- Ironwood exit — managing founder-CEO [Michael Devlin](../people/michael-devlin.md) through
  the process.
- Filling the associate seat left open when [Daniel Kim](../people/daniel-kim.md) departed.

## Working style
- Numbers-first: wants the MOIC/IRR, the entry multiple, and the downside case before the story.
- Bias to a crisp one-page memo over a long deck; reads QoE and legal markups closely.
- Protective of Friday mornings for LP calls and reading; guards them from internal meetings.
